task.question: In ice hockey, which team won their first Walter Cup on May 20, 2026?
task.evidence: May 20: The Montreal Victoire defeat the Ottawa Charge three games to one in the 2026 Walter Cup Finals to win their first Walter Cup.

answer:

FINAL: Montreal Victoire

[Walter Cup] The Walter Cup (French: La coupe Walter) is the championship trophy awarded to the winner of the Walter Cup playoffs (French: Séries éliminatoires de la Coupe Walter de la LPHF), which culminate in an annual best-of-five series that determines the champion of the Professional Women's Hockey League (PWHL). The trophy is named in honour of PWHL co-founders and spouses Mark Walter and Kimbra Walter. Two teams have won the Cup since its establishment: the Minnesota Frost in both 2024 and 2025, and the Montreal Victoire in 2026. The Walter Cup is permanently on display at the Hockey Hall of Fame in Toronto. In contrast to the Stanley Cup, a replica of the Walter Cup is made for each year's champions.

The biggest night in world soccer was delayed 45 minutes due to traffic and congestion getting into the London Palladium, but once the 70th edition of the ceremony began, it delivered plenty to talk about. All eyes were on a wide-open race for the men's award, where Harry Kane held off stiff competition from Lamine Yamal and Kylian Mbappé to take soccer's most prestigious individual honor. On the women's side, Alexia Putellas took home a third career Ballon d'Or Femenin title, beating the likes of Ewa Pajor and Melchie Dumornay to the award that was dominated by Aitana Bonmatí for the past three years. Spain and Spanish clubs' dominance was a major talking point on the night: Luis de la Fuente took home best men's coach after winning the 2026 World Cup and Pere Romeu of Barcelona Femeni received the honors as best women's coach; Unai Simón and Cata Coll were named best goalkeeper for their heroics with Spain and Barcelona Femeni respectively; Vicky Lopez won a second straight young women's player of the year crown and Lamine Yamal took a third straight young men's player of the year win. Here are all the the latest updates, reactions and winners from London as it happened.

The Walter Cup (French: La coupe Walter) is the championship trophy awarded to the winner of the Walter Cup playoffs (French: Séries éliminatoires de la Coupe Walter de la LPHF), which culminate in an annual best-of-five series that determines the champion of the Professional Women's Hockey League (PWHL).
Two teams have won the Cup since its establishment: the Minnesota Frost in both 2024 and 2025, and the Montreal Victoire in 2026.
In 2026, the Montréal Victoire became the first Canadian team—and the first team other than Minnesota—to win the Walter Cup championship when they defeated the Charge in the Final.
On August 21, 2026, the PWHL reported that the replica of the trophy made for the 2026 champion Victoire went missing while in transit to Lethbridge, Alberta, the hometown of Victoire forward Dara Greig.
== List of winners ==
